title: Paper Crease — Fold, Punch, Unfold
short_desc: Fold the sheet, punch a hole, then picture what the unfolded paper looks like. 120 logic puzzles across 8 chapters, one tap each.
how_to_play: Tap an edge to fold the paper, tap the sheet to punch a hole, then pick the pattern you see after unfolding. Hints cost ink; stars open chapters.
